text: Marta's daughter has her piano recital on May 14 at the community hall. Marta says she's been practising every night and is a nervous wreck about it.

Lunch with Nikhil. His driving test is next Tuesday, third attempt. He failed the last one on a roundabout, so he's booked two extra lessons this weekend. His sister Neha has offered to take him out in her car on Sunday too, though he says she's a worse backseat driver than their dad. He sounded fairly calm about it all, honestly.
Remind me to text Seo-yeon good luck before her audition on Friday.
Chantal and her husband Leon are running the half marathon together on June 3rd. First race for both of them. She's convinced he'll leave her behind at mile two.
Damian's band is playing at the Crown on 5/22. I'm going with Yasmin, she's driving.
Eduardo got his bar exam results back. He passed! His mum apparently cried down the phone.
Call with Rana this evening. Her son Tadhg sits his GCSEs starting May 11, and she says he's barely opened a book. She's more stressed than he is. I should check in with her after the first week.
Sean's five-a-side cup final got called off because the pitch flooded. They're replaying it in a fortnight instead.
Olga mentioned she's started learning the cello. Loves Elgar, hates anything by Philip Glass.
Need to buy tickets for the school play before they sell out. Isabel's playing the lead, opening night is April 30.
Tendai is doing a 10k for the hospice on Sunday, the one that looked after his dad. Don't forget to sponsor him.

Anika's results day is August 13. She needs an A in chemistry for her first choice. Her brother Michael got in there two years ago, so she feels a lot of pressure to match him. Their parents keep saying it doesn't matter, which apparently makes it worse. She's planning to collect the results with her best friend Mai first thing and then ring home.
Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow and drop the library books back.
Ahmed's dog Pepper won best in show at the county fair on Saturday. He was absurdly proud and showed me about forty photos.
Fang has her viola grade 8 exam on March 9. Must message her the night before.

Coffee with Imogen. She's finally booked her theory test for next Thursday. Her boyfriend Thabo keeps quizzing her on road signs at dinner, which she says is not helping at all. She's also thinking about switching jobs in the new year, maybe something in graphic design. She did a short course in it last spring and really loved it.
Alina and Mai have tickets for the Arsenal match on the 18th. Mai's never been to a live game.
Santiago didn't get through the second round of auditions for the orchestra. He's gutted but says he'll try again next year. I should take him out for a pint this week.
Neha's little sister is performing in a dance competition in Birmingham on July 6th. Neha's driving her up the night before.
Thomas plays bass in a jazz trio on Wednesdays. Mostly standards, a bit of bossa nova.
Elif told me her nephew passed his driving test yesterday on the first go. Whole family went out for curry to celebrate.
Isla Hughes has her dissertation presentation on May 2nd and she's terrified of public speaking. Remind me to ask her how it went that afternoon.

Mehmet's wrestling tournament is in Leeds this weekend. His wife Shira says he's been cutting weight for weeks and is in a foul mood. Weigh-in is Friday night and the first bout is Saturday morning around ten. Shira is taking their two kids to watch, assuming he doesn't snap at all of them before then.
Shira is doing her nursing finals in June. She's been revising with Elif most evenings.
Gym at 7, then the dentist at 10:30. Groceries after if there's time.

Rang Uncle Michael about the cricket. His club made the regional final on Sept 14, first time in about twenty years. He's playing even though his knee is bad. Aunt Olga is furious with him about that and says she's not going to watch if he insists on playing. I think he's secretly hoping I'll drive up and cheer him on. Could make a weekend of it.
Marta mentioned her husband Eduardo has been learning Portuguese for a work trip. He's sitting a language proficiency test on June 20th.
Don't forget to get Damian something for the gig, maybe a nice set of drumsticks. He keeps going on about the Vic Firth ones.
Seo-yeon's audition went well apparently, she got a callback for May 27. Her mum is flying in from Seoul to watch the final round if she gets that far.
Nikhil passed his driving test! Third time lucky. He's already asking to borrow his dad's car.
Chantal finished the half marathon in 2:14. Leon pulled a calf muscle around mile ten and walked the rest, so she's been teasing him all week. I need to send her the photos I took at the finish line.

Yasmin has a big exam for her accountancy qualification on Monday. She's been working full time and studying at weekends and sounds completely exhausted. Need to drop off some food on Saturday so she doesn't have to cook.
Tendai's daughter Rana has her first swimming gala next Saturday. He's more nervous than she is.
The quiz night on Friday is off, Sean's got Covid. Probably rescheduling to next month.
Met Olga's partner, Thabo, for the first time. Really nice guy. He coaches an under-12s rugby team and has a tournament on October 25.
I'm doing the parkrun on Saturday and the Great North Run in September. Should probably start training properly.

Isabel's drama school audition is on 3/15 in London. She's doing a Shakespeare monologue and a song from Les Mis. Her dad's taking her down on the train the day before. I should send her a good luck card early next week so it arrives in time.
Anika says her mum is retaking her driving test after twenty-odd years off the road. It's this Friday at 9am and she hasn't slept properly in days.
Ahmed Khan and his twin brother Mehmet are both sitting the police entrance exam on April 8. Ahmed thinks Mehmet will smash it and he'll scrape through.
Fang loves Studio Ghibli and collects the soundtrack vinyls. Has pretty much everything except Porco Rosso, which would make a great birthday present.
Text Imogen tomorrow to see how her theory test went.
Mai's cat Mochi has to go to the vet on Thursday for a dental. She's dreading the bill more than anything.

Spent half an hour on the phone with Santiago. His brother Leon is competing in a national chess championship on November 2nd in Manchester and Santiago is going to watch. Their parents can't make it because their dad's recovering from a hip operation. Santiago sounded a bit flat about the whole family situation, said it's been a rough year. Remind me to call him after the weekend.
Neha's driving test is May 19. She's had about sixty lessons.
Thomas got the part of Mr. Darcy in the amateur production of Pride and Prejudice. Shows run June 12 through June 15. Must get tickets for the Saturday.
Elif's mum is doing her citizenship test next Wednesday. Elif has been helping her with the history questions every evening.
Isla said her younger brother Tadhg got into the county youth orchestra. He plays the French horn.
Need to renew the car insurance before Friday.
Mehmet won his weight class! Shira sent a video of him crying on the podium. Should send him a congratulations card.
Damian's gig was brilliant, the place was packed. He said a guy from a label came up afterwards, so fingers crossed something comes of it. Ask him next week if they've been in touch.
Rana has a work presentation on Thursday to the whole board. She's dreading it and has been rehearsing in front of her cat, Biscuit.
Sean's wife Alina is running the London Marathon in April. They're both vegetarian, so if I host the fundraising dinner I need to plan a menu around that.

Chatted to Marta after choir. Her son Santiago has his grade 5 trumpet on June 1st, her daughter Mia has a gymnastics competition the weekend after, and her husband is away for both. She's juggling all of it on her own and sounded exhausted. I offered to take Mia to the competition so Marta can stay with Santiago for his exam. Need to confirm with her by Wednesday.
Michael Okafor, everyone calls him Mikey, is trying out for the county football team on Saturday morning. He's fifteen and absolutely obsessed with Liverpool.
Chantal's sister Isla passed her PhD viva today with minor corrections. Chantal's organising drinks on Friday.
I'm sitting my motorbike CBT on the 28th. Booked it this morning.
Eduardo's partner Yasmin got her first-choice uni place. She starts in September. Eduardo said she's dropped hints about wanting a decent pair of headphones for her commute.

Nikhil's grandad turns 90 on July 9th. The family's throwing a party at the cricket club and Nikhil is giving a speech, which he is quietly panicking about. His cousin Shira is helping him write it, and they're planning a slideshow of old photos too. Their grandad apparently has no idea about any of it. I'm invited, so I should get a card and something small for him.
Kids' sports day is next Friday. Must remember the sun cream and packed lunches.

Fang's recital went amazingly yesterday, she played the Bach without a single mistake. Her teacher wants her to enter the regional competition on 6/8. I should ask her tomorrow whether she's going to do it.
